stronghold.name: Perihelion House
stronghold.location: Sigil - Border of the Clerk's Ward and Market Ward
stronghold.frequency: Once per short or long rest (Initiative Count 20, losing ties)

facilities.name: Portal Conflux
facilities.boon: Maintains up to 3 two-way Gate portals (indefinite duration, no slot/material/concentration, cannot forcibly draw creatures). Only dispelled by 7th+ level Dispel Magic; reforms after 30 days.

facilities.name: Invocation Chamber
facilities.boon: Permanent Magic Circle dais (DC 15). 1/day (5th+ level spellcaster): Contact Other Plane (adv on Int save) or Scrying (target dis on Wis save) without a slot. 1/30 days (6th+ level spellcaster): Planar Ally without a slot (bound to room for 8h, cannot harm summoner in room).

facilities.name: Gardens
facilities.boon: Daily: 3 magical fruits granting Lesser Restoration (lasts 24h). 1/30 days (8h work or 7 days by Tarin): Create Midnight Tears, Pale Tincture, Potion of Greater Healing, Torpor, or Truth Serum.

facilities.name: Training Rooms
facilities.boon: 7 days training and meditation grants Advantage on two random saving throws (1d6) for the next 7 days.

facilities.name: Tavern (The Spice Rack)
facilities.boon: 1/7 days spy network (location events over next 7 days OR familiar creature's location and past 7 days' movements). 'The Tallest Halfling' stout grants Enlarge for 24 hours (no save).

facilities.name: Dining Hall
facilities.boon: 1/30 days banquet (1h prep, 1h consume): Heroes' Feast feeding twice as many creatures.

facilities.name: Headquarters
facilities.boon: 7 days planning: Roll two d20s. For the next 7 days, replace any attack roll, saving throw, or ability check made by yourself or a creature you can see (each used once, max 1/turn).

actions.name: Power Chord
actions.description: Until initiative count 20 on the next round, all inspiration dice produce their maximum result when rolled, followed by the sounding of a two-note chord: one root note and another a fifth higher than the root.

actions.name: An End to Suffering
actions.description: Until initiative count 20 on the next round, transcend your physical form: you are immune to all but psychic damage, and gain truesight out to 60 feet.

actions.name: Arcane Apotheosis
actions.description: Immediately cast three spells from your list of known spells, using spell slots as normal.

actions.name: Swift and Certain
actions.description: Until initiative count 20 on the next round, all enemies within 60 feet of you are marked for death. The first time you hit a marked enemy on a turn, roll half the number of Sneak Attack dice for your level (round up) - the marked creature takes necrotic damage equal to the roll's total.

actions.name: Aflame with the Ashen Gaze
actions.description: Shafts of golden light stab down from the sky, penetrating walls and ceilings, targeting all hostile creatures within 60 feet (even hidden or invisible). Roll a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier - creatures who fail a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC take radiant damage equal to your roll.

turnActions.description: On its turn, the spelljammer can take 3 actions (2 if <20 crew, 1 if <10 crew, 0 if <3 crew), choosing from: Fire Eldritch Blasters, Fire Magic Missile Silos, or Move (with Piercing Ram).

armament.name: Eldritch Blasters
armament.notes: Swirling magical glyphs on the ship's hull. Requires 1 action to aim, and 1 action to make 4 attacks.

armament.name: Magic Missile Silos
armament.notes: 1 action to make 2 attacks. If the spelljammer does not move on its turn, these attacks hit automatically.

armament.name: Piercing Ram
armament.notes: Melee Weapon Attack as part of Move into another object or Gargantuan creature. Hit: 88 (16d10) piercing; Vagrant takes half damage and comes to a dead stop. Miss: No damage, target moves to nearest unoccupied space, Vagrant continues moving.

specialSystems.name: Spelljammer Helm
specialSystems.effect: Requires attunement by a creature with Spellcasting or Pact Magic. Maintain concentration while sitting in it to propel/maneuver the ship, see and hear on/around the vessel from any chosen spot aboard, fire ship weaponry, and use Immovable Anchors and Portal Conflux.

specialSystems.name: Storm Drive
specialSystems.effect: While attuned to the helm, cast Fog Cloud at will (30 ft. tall, 120-ft. radius cylinder centered on lowest point of hull; moves with ship; cannot be dispersed by strong winds; attuned spelljammer can see through the fog).

specialSystems.name: Immovable Anchors (4)
specialSystems.effect: 2 at bow, 2 at stern; act like immovable rods. Attuned spelljammer activates/deactivates at will without crew to suspend ship in mid-air. Activating while moving damages the hull.

specialSystems.name: Portal Conflux
specialSystems.effect: As an action while attuned to the helm and touching the ship, cast Plane Shift on the Vagrant and all aboard (1/24 hours, or by expending a 7th+ level slot if known). Cannot be used if any creatures are inside the Special Quarters.

specialSystems.name: Special Quarters
specialSystems.effect: Officers' mess and quarters in a demiplane accessed next to the Spelljammer's quarters. Immune to all divination magic.
